patch_description: Revert to the best-performing shared-parameter CRZ entangler pattern (score 0.63) instead of the current unshared version with an extra rz_pre layer (score 0.58), which increased parameter count and depth without benefit. Additionally, insert a lightweight mid-layer of five RY rotations on wires [1,3,5,7,8] between the entangling CRZ block and the final RZ layer. This reallocates a small amount of capacity to amplitude-encoding rotations right after entanglement, which should help the model better exploit the correlations created by the CRZ block before the final phase-encoding RZ layer, while keeping the overall depth and parameter count close to the well-performing baseline.
